simple.meaning: עֵצָה (ʻêtsâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “advice ; by implication, plan ; also prudence.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 90 times across Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 13 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:28. Its contexts include family, kingship, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵצָה (H6098).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֵצָה (ʻêtsâh) / H6098 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:28, Judges 20:7, 2 Samuel 15:31, 2 Samuel 15:34 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: advice ; by implication, plan ; also prudence
definitions.full: H6098. etsah עֵצָה noun feminine counsel, advice (= (יְ)עֵצָה ) — ׳ע Judg 20:7 28 t.; construct עֲצַת Isa 5:19 33t.; suffix עֲצָתִי Prov 1:25 5 t. (+ Isa 46:11 Qr; Kt עצתו better); עֲצָֽתְךָ Psa 20:5 ; 73:24 ; עֲצָתוֺ Hosea 10:6-7 t. (including Isa 46:10 Kt see supr); עֲצָתָם Jer 18:23 4 t.; plural עֵצוֺת Deut 32:28 2 t.; עֲצָתָ֑יִךְ Isa 47:13 ; — counsel, advice 2Sam 15:31 , 34 ; 16:23 (twice in verse); 17:14 (3 t. in verse); 17:23 ; 1Kin 12:8 , 13 , 14 2Chr 10:8 ; 10:13 ; 10:14 , 22:5 ; 25:16 ; Ezra 10:3 (where read ׳ע אֲדֹנִי Reuss Ry), 10:8 ; Job 29:21 ; political consultation Isa 47:13 ; as accusative of congnate meaning with verb 2Sam 17:7 ; 1Kin 1:12 ; Isa 8:10 ; Ezek 11:2 ( עצתרָֿע , || אָוֶן ); with הָב֫וּ give counsel Judg 20:7 ; 2Sam 16:20 ; ע ׳חֵבִיא Isa 16:3 ; ע ׳עשׂה 30:1 ; בְּנַפְשִׁי עֵצוֺת אָשִׁית Psa 13:3 ; = design, purpose Ezra 4:5 ; Neh 4:9 ; 1Chr 12:20 (Baer), Psa 14:6 ; 20:5 ; Jer 18:23 (followed by עַל = against ), 49:30 (|| מַחֲשָׁבָה ); עֲצַתגּֿוֺיִם Psa 33:10 ; suitable counsel for war (= Generalship) 2Kin 18:20 = Isa 36:5 (compare Prov 20:18 below); also שָׁלוֺם עֲצַת Zech 6:13 counsel of peace ; practical wisdom, sagacity Isa 19:3 , compare 19:11 , Jer 19:7 ; Deut 32:28 (|| תְּבוּנָה ), Hosea 10:6 . Especially in Wisdom Literature and prophets; counsel = good counsle, wisdom Job 38:2 ; 42:3 ; Prov 12:15 ; 20:5 (its seat בְּלֶבאִֿישׁ ); || תּוּשִׁיָּה 8:14 ; Isa 28:29 (of ׳י ); || חָכְמָה Jer 49:7 ; || חָכְמָה and תְּבוּנָה Job 12:13 ; Prov 21:30 ; || מוּסָר 19:20 ; || תַּחְבֻּלוֺת 20:18 (compare Isa 36:5 above); ׳ע נִפְתָּלִים Job 5:13 ; ע ׳רוּחַ וּגְבוּרָה Isa 11:2 (|| ׳ר וּבָינָה חָכְמָה ); hearty counsel ׳ע נֶפֶשׁ Prov 27:9 ; counsel of wisdom , when wisdom is personified 1:25 , 30 (|| תּוֺכַחַת ); in bad sense ׳ע רשׁעים Job 10:3 ; 21:16 ; 22:18 ; Psa 1:1 , compare Job 18:7 ; Psa 106:43 ; Isa 29:15 ; of plan of ׳י ; ׳ע ׳י Psa 33:11 ; Prov 19:21 ; Isa 19:17 ; 14:26 ( ׳הע הַיִעוּצָה ), 25:1 ; 46:10-11 , ׳ע ישׂראל קדושׁ 5:19 ; also Micah 4:12 ; Jer 32:19 ( הָעֵצָה גְּדֹל ), 49:20 ; 50:45 ; Psa 106:13 ; ׳ע עֶלְיוֺן 107:11 ; instruction, guiding wisdom of ׳י 73:24 ; אִישׁעֲֿצָתוֺ i.e. counsellor of ׳י Isa 40:13 ; in figure עֲצָתִי אַנְשֵׁי Psa 119:24 = my counsellors , said of testimonies of God; = prophecy , ׳ע מלאכיו Isa 44:26 (|| עַבְדּוֺ דְּבַר ); ע ׳תִּאֹבַד מִזְּקֵנִים Ezek 7:26 (compare 1Kin 12:8 ; || תּוֺרָה חָזוֺן, ), מֵחָכָם Jer 18:18 (|| תּוֺרָה דָּבָר, ).
